ऐ: ऐ 1. ऐ, the twelfth vowel of the alphabet, having the sound of ei in heighth. —ऐ-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound ऐ।
ऐ 2. ऐ, ind. (an interjection of calling or summoning) Hola, Ho, Heigh; (and of remembering) Aye, Ha.
ऐ 3. ऐ, ऐस्, m. an epithet of Śiva.
ऐकध्य: ऐकध्य ऐकध्य, अम्, n. (fr. एकधा), single-ness of time or occurrence; (अम् or अतस्), ind. at once, together.
ऐकपत्य: ऐकपत्य, अम्, n. (fr. एक-पति), the sovereignty of one, absolute monarchy; supreme authority.
ऐकपदिक: ऐकपदिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एक-पद), belonging to a simple word; consisting of single words; the N. given to the Naigama section of Yāska's commentary on the Nighaṇṭavas, or collection of Vedic words.
ऐकपद्य: ऐकपद्य, अम्, n. unity of words.
ऐकभाव्य: ऐकभाव्य, अम्, n. (fr. एक-भाव), singleness of nature.
ऐकमत्य: ऐकमत्य, अम्, n. (fr. एक-मति), unanimity, sameness of doctrine or of opinion, agreement, con-sent, concurrence, confederation; (अस्, ई, अम्), con-nected with sameness of opinion.
ऐकलव्य: ऐकलव्य, अस्, m. a patronymic fr. एक-लू।
ऐकशतिक: ऐकशतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एक-शत), provided with 101.
ऐकशफ: ऐकशफ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एक-शफ), produced by or belonging to animals with uncloven hoofs.
ऐकश्रुत्य: ऐकश्रुत्य, अम्, n. (fr. एक-श्रुति, q. v.), the one accentless monotonous tone, monotony.
ऐकसहस्रिक: ऐकसहस्रिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एक-सहस्र), pro-vided with 1001.
ऐकस्वर्य: ऐकस्वर्य, अम्, n. (fr. एक-स्वर), oneness of accent (as in the case of a compound which has only one accent, though the separate members when un-compounded are each accented).
ऐकागारिक: ऐकागारिक, अस्, ई, m. f. (fr. एक-आगार), a thief, a robber breaking into lonely houses; the possessor of one residence.
ऐकाग्र्य: ऐकाग्र्य, अम्, n. (fr. एकाग्र), intentness on one object.
ऐकाङ्ग: ऐकाङ्ग, अस्, m. (fr. एकाङ्ग), a soldier of the body-guard.
ऐकात्म्य: ऐकात्म्य, अम्, n. (fr. एक-आत्मन्), unity of the soul, unity of being; oneness with the supreme spirit.
ऐकादशाक्ष: ऐकादशाक्ष, अस्, m. (fr. एकादश + अक्ष), N. of a man.
ऐकादशिन: ऐकादशिन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एकादशिनी), Ved. be-longing to a collection or association of eleven.
ऐकाधिकरण्य: ऐकाधिकरण्य, अम्, n. (fr. एक + अधिकरण), oneness of relation.
ऐकान्तिक: ऐकान्तिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एकान्त), absolute, com-plete, perfect.
ऐकान्यिक: ऐकान्यिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एक + अन्य), one who commits a single error in reading (who makes one thing another or otherwise than right).
ऐकार्थ्य: ऐकार्थ्य, अम्, n. (fr. एकार्थ), oneness of aim or intention.
ऐकाहिक: ऐकाहिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एकाह), ephemeral, quotidian, of one day, of the same day; belonging to a ceremony which lasts one day, belonging to a simple oblation.
ऐक्य: ऐक्य, अम्, n. (fr. एक), oneness, unity, single-ness, identity, harmony, sameness; the identity of the human soul or of the universe with the Deity; an aggregate, whole, total; (in alg.) the product of the length and depth of the portions, or of the little excavations differing in depth.
ऐक्षव: ऐक्षव ऐक्षव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. इक्षु), pro-duced from or relating to the sugar-cane, sugary; (अम्), n. sugar.
ऐक्षव्य: ऐक्षव्य, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. produced from or re-lating to the sugar-cane.
ऐक्षुक: ऐक्षुक, अस्, ई, अम्, suitable for sugar-cane; bearing sugar-cane; (अस्), m. a carrier of sugar-canes; (आस्), m. pl. the inhabitants of Ikṣukīyā.
ऐक्षुभारिक: ऐक्षुभारिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. इक्षु-भार), carrying a load of sugar-canes.
ऐक्ष्वाक: ऐक्ष्वाक ऐक्ष्वाक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. इक्ष्वाकु), belonging to Ikṣvāku, of the family of Ikṣvāku; (अस्), m. a descendant of Ikṣvāku; epithet of Puru-kutsa, and of Daśaratha.
ऐक्ष्वाकु: ऐक्ष्वाकु, उस्, m. a descendant of Ikṣvāku; epithet of Triśaṅku, and of Rāma.
ऐङ्गुद: ऐङ्गुद ऐङ्गुद, अस्, ई, अम्, produced from the Iṅguda plant; (अम्), n. scil. फलम्, the fruit of the Iṅguda plant.
ऐच्छिक: ऐच्छिक ऐच्छिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. इच्छा), optional, voluntary, arbitrary, at will.
ऐड: ऐड ऐड, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. इडा), Ved. contain-ing anything refreshing or strengthening; containing the word इडा; (अस्), m. the son of Iḍā, epithet of Purūravas; [cf. ऐल।]
ऐडक: ऐडक ऐडक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एडक), produced from the animal Eḍaka; (अस्), m. a species of sheep.
ऐडविड: ऐडविड ऐडविड, अस्, m. an epithet of Kuvera; N. of a son of Daśaratha; also ऐडविल; [cf. ऐलविल।]
ऐडुक: ऐडुक ऐडुक or ऐडूक, अम्, n. a wall &c. of bones and rubbish. See एडुक।
ऐण: ऐण ऐण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एण), produced from or belonging to the male black antelope.
ऐणिक: ऐणिक, अस्, ई, अम्, hunting black antelopes, a deer-killer.
ऐणेय: ऐणेय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एणी), produced from the black doe or female antelope; produced from any-thing belonging to a black doe or female antelope; (अस्), m. the black antelope; (अम्), n. a kind of coitus.
ऐण्डिनेय: ऐण्डिनेय ऐण्डिनेय, आस्, m. pl., N. of a Śākhā or branch of the Veda.
ऐतदात्म्य: ऐतदात्म्य ऐतदात्म्य, अम्, n. (abstr. noun of एतदात्मन्), the state of having this property or peculiarity.
ऐतरेय: ऐतरेय ऐतरेय, अस्, m. a descendant of Itarā, to whom the Aitareya-Brāhmaṇa and Āraṇyaka were revealed; (अस्, ई, अम्), originating from Aitareya. —ऐतरेय-ब्राह्मण or ऐतरेयक, अम्, n. (scil. ब्राह्मण) title of a Brāhmaṇa attached to the Ṛg-veda and prescribing the duties of the Hotṛ priest. It consists of forty Adhyāyas, divided into eight Pañcikās. —ऐतरेयोपनिषद् (°य-उप्°), त्, f., N. of an Upaniṣad forming part of the Aitareya-Āraṇyaka. —ऐतरेयोपनिषद्-भाष्य, अम्, n. a commentary on the last by Saṅkarācārya. —ऐतरे-योपनिषद्भाष्य-टिप्पणी, f., N. of a commen-tary on the last work by Anantānandagiri.
ऐतरेयिन्: ऐतरेयिन्, ई, m. a follower of Aitareya, a reader of the Aitareya-Brāhmaṇa.
ऐतश: ऐतश ऐतश, अस्, m., N. of a Muni of the family of Aurva (Bhṛgu), author of the Aitaśa-pralāpa forming part of the Kuntāpa hymns of the Atharva-veda and used with these hymns in the ritual belonging to the Ṛg-veda.
ऐतशायन: ऐतशायन, आस्, m. pl. the descendants of Aitaśa.
ऐतिशायन: ऐतिशायन, अस्, m., N. of a teacher.
ऐतिहासिक: ऐतिहासिक ऐतिहासिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. इति-हास), derived from ancient legends, legendary, historical, traditional; (अस्), m. one who relates or knows ancient legends, an historian.
ऐतिह्य: ऐतिह्य ऐतिह्य, अम्, n. (fr. इति-ह; see under इति, p. 139), traditional instruction.
ऐदंयुगीन: ऐदंयुगीन ऐदंयुगीन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. इदं-युग), fit for this yoke or team.
ऐध्: ऐध् ऐध्, f. or ऐध, अस्, m. or ऐधा, f. (fr. rt. इन्ध् with आ), Ved. flaming, a flame, splendor.
ऐन: ऐन ऐन, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
ऐनस: ऐनस ऐनस, अम्, n. (fr. एनस्), sin.
ऐन्दव: ऐन्दव ऐन्दव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. इन्दु), lunar, belonging or relating or similar to the moon; (ई), f. the plant Serratula Anthelminthica; (अम्), n. the asterism Mṛgaśiras.
ऐन्द्र: ऐन्द्र ऐन्द्र, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. इन्द्र), belonging to or sacred to Indra, proceeding from Indra, similar to Indra; (अस्), m. the part of a sacrifice offered to Indra; (ई), f. (scil. ऋच्) a verse addressed to Indra; (scil. दिश्) the east quarter, of which Indra is regent (e. g. ऐन्द्र्यां दिशि, in the east); the eighteenth lunar mansion; the eighth day in the second half of the month Mārgaśīrṣa, and of the month Pauṣa; Indra's energy, personified as his wife and by some identified with Durgā; epithet of Durgā; misfortune, misery (personified); N. of a plant, a kind of cucum-ber, Cucumis Madraspatanus; (अम्), n. the eighteenth lunar mansion (ज्येष्ठा); wild ginger.
ऐन्द्रजालिक: ऐन्द्रजालिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. इन्द्र-जाल), familiar with or relating to magic, magical, deceptive, illusory; (अस्), m. a juggler.
ऐन्द्रतुरीय: ऐन्द्रतुरीय, अस्, ई, अम्, a libation (ग्रह) &c., the fourth part of which is offered to Indra.
ऐन्द्रद्युम्न: ऐन्द्रद्युम्न, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to Indra-dyumna; N. of a country.
ऐन्द्रलुप्तिक: ऐन्द्रलुप्तिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. इन्द्र-लुप्त), afflicted with morbid baldness of the head.
ऐन्द्रवायव: ऐन्द्रवायव, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. belonging to Indra and Vāyu.
ऐन्द्रशिर: ऐन्द्रशिर, अस्, m. a species of elephant.
ऐन्द्राग्न: ऐन्द्राग्न, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. sacred to or belonging to Indra and Agni, proceeding from Indra and Agni.
ऐन्द्रानैरृत: ऐन्द्रानैरृत, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to Indra and Nirṛti.
ऐन्द्रापौष्ण: ऐन्द्रापौष्ण, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to Indra and Pūṣan.
ऐन्द्राबार्हस्पत्य: ऐन्द्राबार्हस्पत्य, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to Indra and Bṛhaspati.
ऐन्द्रामारुत: ऐन्द्रामारुत, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to Indra and the Maruts.
ऐन्द्रायुध: ऐन्द्रायुध, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to Indra's bow or the rainbow.
ऐन्द्रावरुण: ऐन्द्रावरुण, अस्, ई, अम्, sacred to Indra and Varuṇa.
ऐन्द्रावैष्णव: ऐन्द्रावैष्णव, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to Indra and Viṣṇu.
ऐन्द्रासौम्य: ऐन्द्रासौम्य, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to Indra and Soma.
ऐन्द्रि: ऐन्द्रि, इस्, m. a patronymic of Jayanta, the son of Indra; N. of Arjuna; N. of the monkey-king Bāli; a crow.
ऐन्द्रिय: ऐन्द्रिय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. इन्द्रिय and connected with इन्द्र, q. v.), relating to or belonging to the senses, sensual; perceptible, perceived, present; (अम्), n. the world of the senses; a section of the Āyur-veda treating on the senses.
ऐन्द्रियक: ऐन्द्रियक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the senses; perceptible.
ऐन्द्रियेधी: ऐन्द्रिये-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, thinking only of sensual pleasure.
ऐन्धन: ऐन्धन ऐन्धन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. इन्धन), consisting of fuel; an epithet of the sun.
ऐभावत: ऐभावत ऐभावत, अस्, m. (fr. इभा-वत्), a patronymic of Pratīdarśa.
ऐभी: ऐभी ऐभी, f., N. of a plant; = इभ्या ?
ऐयत्य: ऐयत्य ऐयत्य, अम्, n. (fr. इयत्), quantity, number, value.
ऐरंमद: ऐरंमद ऐरंमद, अस्, m. (fr. इरंमद), a patronymic of Deva-muni, author of a Ṛg-veda hymn.
ऐरंमदीय: ऐरंमदीय, अम्, n., N. of a sea in Brahmā's world.
ऐरावण: ऐरावण ऐरावण, अस्, m. (fr. इरा-वन् = इरा-वत्, ‘possessed of or proceeding from water’), N. of a king of the Nāgas; Indra's elephant, pro-duced at the churning of the ocean.
ऐरावत: ऐरावत, अस्, m. a patronymic of a fabulous serpent-like being called Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; a serpent, one of the chiefs of the Nāgas or serpent-race, inhabiting the lower world or Pātāla; N. of the elephant of Indra, produced at the churning of the ocean, and the pro-totype of the elephant race, considered also as the elephant of the east quarter; [cf. नाग, which means both serpent and elephant]; an excellent elephant; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a kind of rainbow, considered as the long and unbent bow of Indra; a kind of lightning; (अस्), m. the orange tree; another tree, Artocarpus Lacucha; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a vast and waterless region; (आनि), n. pl., N. of a Varṣa; N. of the northern path of the moon; the fruit of the tree Artocarpus Lacucha; (ई), f. the female of Indra's elephant; lightning; N. of a plant; N. of the Ravi river in the Pañjāb; N. of a particular portion of the moon's path.
ऐरिण: ऐरिण ऐरिण, अम्, n. (fr. इरिण), fossil or rock salt.
ऐरेय: ऐरेय ऐरेय, अम्, n. (fr. इरा), a spirituous liquor.
ऐर्म्य: ऐर्म्य ऐर्म्य, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. ईर्मा), good for healing wounds, (a plaster &c.)
ऐल: ऐल ऐल, अस्, m. (= ऐड), N. of Purūravas as son of Ilā; (अम्), n. a particular number. —ऐल-धान, अम्, n., N. of a town.
ऐलब: ऐलब ऐलब, अस्, m., Ved. noise, roaring, cry. —ऐलब-कार, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. making a noise, roaring (epithet of Rudra's dogs).
ऐलबृद: ऐलबृद ऐलबृद, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. bringing food; (perhaps related to ऐलब।)
ऐलवालुक: ऐलवालुक ऐलवालुक, अम्, n. a perfume. See एलवालु।
ऐलविल: ऐलविल ऐलविल, अस्, m., N. of Kuvera as son of Ilavilā; (also ऐडविद, ऐडविल, and एल-विल); N. of a king.
ऐलूष: ऐलूष ऐलूष, अस्, m. (fr. इलूष), a patrony-mic of Kavasha, the author of two Ṛg-veda hymns.
ऐलेय: ऐलेय ऐलेय, अम्, n. a perfume; = एलवालु।
ऐश: ऐश ऐश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. ईश), proceeding from or relating to Śiva; divine, supreme, regal.
ऐशान: ऐशान, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. ईशान), belonging to Śiva; (ई), f. (scil. दिश्) the quarter of Śiva, the north-east quarter. —ऐशान-ज, आस्, m. pl. = ईशान-ज, q. v.
ऐशिक: ऐशिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to Śiva; divine, heavenly; royal, regal.
ऐश्वर: ऐश्वर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. ईश्वर), fit for or belong-ing to or produced by a master, or by the supreme lord; mighty, majestic; divine, relating to God; supreme, royal; belonging to Śiva.
ऐश्वरिक: ऐश्वरिक, अस्, m. (with Buddhists) a theist.
ऐश्वर्य: ऐश्वर्य, अम्, n. power, might, sway; dominion; supremacy; superhuman power; the divine faculties of omnipresence, omnipotence, invisibility, &c. (some-times their number is given as five, with reference to the five elements). —ऐश्वर्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, en-dowed with superhuman faculties, possessed of super-natural powers, connected with them.
ऐषमस्: ऐषमस् ऐषमस्, ind. (ऐ related to ए or इ in एतद् or इदम्, and समस् from समा, ‘year’), during this year, in the present year; [cf. Gr. σῆτες σήμερον]
ऐषमस्तन: ऐषमस्तन, अस्, ई, अम्, or ऐषमस्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, of or belonging to the present year.
ऐषावीर: ऐषावीर ऐषावीर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एष-वीर ?), Ved. weak, powerless.
ऐषीक: ऐषीक ऐषीक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. इषीका), con-sisting of stalks made of reeds or cane; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; ऐषीकम् पर्व, a section of the tenth book or Sauptika-parva of the Mahā-bhārata (Adhyāya 10-18).
ऐषुकारि: ऐषुकारि ऐषुकारि, अयस्, m. pl. (fr. इषु-कार), N. of a tribe or caste. —ऐषुकारि-भक्त, अम्, n. the country inhabited by this tribe.
ऐष्टक: ऐष्टक ऐष्टक, अम्, n. (fr. इष्टका), Ved. the sacrificial bricks collectively.
ऐष्टिक: ऐष्टिक ऐष्टिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 3. इष्टि), sacrificial, ceremonial.
ऐष्टिकपौर्तिक: ऐष्टिकपौर्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the Iṣṭāpūrta, ceremonial and meritorious.
ऐहलौकिक: ऐहलौकिक ऐहलौकिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. इह-लोक), of this world, happening in this world, terres-trial, sublunary; (opposed to पारलौकिक।)
ऐहिक: ऐहिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. इह), of this place, of this world, temporal, worldly, secular, local; (opposed to आमुष्मिक।) —ऐहिक-दर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, worldly-minded, concerned about worldly affairs.
ऐकगुण्य: ऐकगुण्य, अम्, n. (fr. एक-गुण), the value of a single unit, simple unity (opposed to द्वैगुण्य).
ऐदम्पर्य: ऐदम्पर्य, अम्, n. (fr. इदम् + पर), ‘the state of being devoted to this alone,’ main or only object, chief end.
ऐन्द्रनील: ऐन्द्रनील, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. इन्द्र-नील), made of sapphire.
ऐश्य: ऐश्य, अम्, n. (fr. ईश), supremacy, power.
